module.name: License Activation Gate
module.description: Cloud-agnostic apply-then-gate for the BNK License CR. Waits for the licenses.k8s.f5net.com CRD, server-side-applies the License CR (k8s.f5net.com/v1, connected mode, JWT inlined to a 0600 temp file, never logged), then polls .status.state until Active; dumps pod diagnostics and fails closed on timeout. Ported from awsbnkctl phase23_license.go + phase25_activation_poll.go. Closes the D-017 licensing-success gap for the BNK blueprint.

required.name: license_namespace
required.description: Namespace the License CR is applied into — where FLO runs (gold-standard: f5-cne-core; aws-eks-bnk23-traffic blueprint passes this).

required.name: jwt_token
required.description: Raw F5 BNK JWT licensing token. Inlined into spec.jwt. Never logged.

optional.name: license_name
optional.description: Name of the License CR to apply and poll.

optional.name: operation_mode
optional.description: License operationMode. Connected only (air-gapped out of scope).

optional.name: license_crd_name
optional.description: Fully-qualified License CRD name for the CRD pre-gate.

key_outputs.name: license_active
key_outputs.description: Gate output — null_resource id produced only after the operator reported License .status.state == Active.
